report_id: # SCHEMA DOCUMENTATION — NO FAKE METRICS
# Purpose: Out-of-vocabulary (OOV) Arabizi evaluation set.
#   OOV = reports containing at least one meaningful Arabizi token that is NOT in the
#   production vocabulary. Used to measure:
#     - OOV detection rate (can we flag unknown tokens?)
#     - OOV routing accuracy (correct HITL escalation on HIGH-risk OOV?)
#     - OOV false-positive rate (do harmless unknown tokens cause wrong sector?)
# Column definitions:
#   report_id         — Unique identifier
#   text              — The report text (may contain unknown tokens)
#   language          — 'arabizi' or 'mixed'
#   oov_tokens        — Semicolon-separated list of tokens verified as OOV (not in vocab)
#   expected_sector   — Ground-truth sector: ROADS | WATER | ELECTRICITY | WASTE | FLOODING | SAFETY | OTHER
#   expected_issue_type — Ground-truth issue_type (UPPER_CASE)
#   expected_severity — Ground-truth severity: LOW | MEDIUM | HIGH | CRITICAL
#   expected_route_entity — Ground-truth route: CDR | MUN | BMLWE | NLWE | SLWE | BWE | RWA | EDL | CD | ISF | MOE | MPWT | HITL
#                           Note: HIGH-risk OOV should typically route to HITL
#   notes             — Reviewer notes

#   native-speaker-approved examples where the OOV tokens have been
#   manually verified as absent from production vocabulary.
